channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 20
item.description:
37 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed old scientists staying idle and getting stuck, corrected their crouch‑walk angle on stairs, and improved overall AI movement.
  • Fixed animals getting stuck in jungle tree charge stacks.
  • Fixed double LOD renderers on corn and salvaged hammer models and resolved disappearing LODs on propane tanks.
  • Medical honey bandage now reduces radiation by 5.
  • Updated fireworks pack with new descriptions, icons, and added a white firework.
  • Improved character customization UI: proper backdrop, fixed black eyes preview, and eyes now follow camera orbit.

World & Creatures

  • Fixed old scientists staying idle and getting stuck, corrected their crouch‑walk angle on stairs, and improved overall AI movement.
  • Fixed animals getting stuck in jungle tree charge stacks.
  • Improved sheep visual quality at distance with better LODs and opaque fur material.
  • Fixed chainlink fence material overrides in all monuments.
  • Fixed double LOD renderers on corn and salvaged hammer models and resolved disappearing LODs on propane tanks.
  • Fixed empty procmap scene that caused missing map content.

Vehicles & Items

  • Added a repairable helipad at the bandit camp, unlocking air vehicle purchases after sufficient resource contributions.
  • Medical honey bandage now reduces radiation by 5.
  • Updated fireworks pack with new descriptions, icons, and added a white firework.

User Interface & Dialogue

  • Fixed "Show use bind" and "Show belt bar binds" settings to apply correctly.
  • Improved character customization UI: proper backdrop, fixed black eyes preview, and eyes now follow camera orbit.
  • Adjusted conversation readout timing for smoother dialogue flow.

Performance & Networking

  • Reduced number of network groups for rooms, improving multiplayer performance.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 18
